Title: Innovative Microbial Chassis for Systems and Synthetic Biology
Summary: Reviews widely used and emerging microbial chassis for systems and synthetic biology, including genetic and metabolic engineering advances for high-value metabolite production.

Title: Mg2+, ATP, and the Control of Bacterial Metabolism
Summary: Reviews how bacteria lower ATP when cytoplasmic Mg2+ is scarce, reshaping metabolism, transcription, and protein turnover.

Title: Putting System Co-Design at the Center of Chemo-Biohybrid CO2 Valorization From Lab to Industrial Scale
Summary: Argues that chemo-biohybrid CO2 valorization should center on joint system co-design so chemical catalysis and microbial cell factories can go from lab to industrial scale.

Title: Development of a Clustering-Based Screening Using Hyperspectral Imaging for High-Producing Strains in Escherichia coli
Summary: Presents a clustering-based hyperspectral-imaging screen that identifies high-producing Escherichia coli colonies without labeled training strains.

Title: High-yield production of protocatechuic acid in Escherichia coli W3110 using metabolic engineering and fermentation process optimization
Summary: Engineers Escherichia coli W3110 for high-yield protocatechuic acid production using metabolic engineering and fermentation process optimization.

Title: Biosynthesis of 4-hydroxyvalerate from glycerol in engineered Pseudomonas putida KT2440 and its application for the production of poly(3-hydroxybutyrate-co-3-hydroxyvalerate-co-4-hydroxy valerate) (P(3HB-co-3HV-co-4HV)) terpolymer
Summary: Engineers Pseudomonas putida KT2440 to convert glycerol to 4-hydroxyvalerate and feeds the product to Cupriavidus necator for P(3HB-co-3HV-co-4HV) terpolymer synthesis.

Title: Development of isopentenol utilization pathway based on cell-free metabolic engineering and its application in multienzyme cascades synthesis
Summary: Develops a cell-free isopentenol utilization pathway that uses seven enzymes to synthesize lycopene without in vivo genetic modification.

Title: Purple Phototrophic Bacteria as a Novel Platform for Coenzyme Q10 Production from CO2, Syngas, and Sulfur Waste Byproducts
Summary: Uses purple phototrophic bacteria as an autotrophic platform for coenzyme Q10 production from CO2, syngas, and sulfur waste byproducts.

Title: FluxSprout: Single-cell metabolic modeling of vascular sprouting in zebrafish
Summary: Presents FluxSprout, a single-cell transcriptomics-informed genome-scale modeling framework that reconstructs Zebrafish-GEM ensembles for 14 endothelial states and screens metabolic dependencies during sprouting angiogenesis.

Title: An integrated identifiability and metabolic flux analysis workflow for reducing and repairing dynamic CHO metabolic models
Summary: Presents an identifiability-and-MFA workflow that reduces a kinetically constrained dFBA model of CHO perfusion culture and uses stoichiometric MFA to repair glutamate and lactate prediction failures.

Title: HGPRGDel: GPR-Aware Learning and Ranking for Growth-Coupled Gene Deletion Design
Summary: Presents HGPRGDel, a GPR-aware learning method that ranks gene-deletion priorities for growth-coupled production and evaluates candidates on e_coli_core, iMM904, and iML1515.

Title: Identification of ferulic acid tolerance targets in engineered Komagataella phaffii by transcriptomics-integrated genome-scale metabolic modeling
Summary: Integrates transcriptomics with an E-Flux genome-scale model of engineered Komagataella phaffii to identify ferulic-acid tolerance targets AGC1 and PAS_chr3_0834.

Title: Nutrient control enables metabolic reconstruction of Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG and analysis of secretions
Summary: Reconstructs the first curated genome-scale metabolic model of Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG by combining draft models, literature, and high-throughput nutrient-requirement data.

Title: Transcriptome-based, genome-scale metabolic modelling of Haemonchus contortus during development and between sexes
Summary: Constructs HaeconGEM, a transcriptome-based genome-scale metabolic model of the parasitic nematode Haemonchus contortus, to compare metabolic capacity across development and sexes.

Title: Engineering Methylobacterium as a C1 biomanufacturing platform: Metabolic architecture, regulatory networks, and synthetic biology strategies
Summary: Reviews Methylobacterium as a C1 biomanufacturing platform, covering methanol metabolic architecture, regulatory networks, and synthetic-biology strategies.

Title: Host-Specific Metabolic Engineering for Microbial Production of Fucosyllactoses
Summary: Reviews host-specific metabolic engineering of Escherichia coli, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, and Yarrowia lipolytica for microbial production of 2'- and 3-fucosyllactose.

Title: Green production of short-chain diols through microbial fermentation and bioconversion: Current advances, challenges, and future perspectives
Summary: Reviews microbial fermentation and bioconversion routes to short-chain diols, comparing pathway design, host engineering, feedstocks, and process economics.

Title: New avenues for fermentative valorization of vinasse with Escherichia coli
Summary: Evaluates sugar-beet vinasse as a carbon source for fermentative production processes in Escherichia coli.
